prompts.Tree:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent game environment sprite, a clustered old woodland boundary oak for an original dark Gothic ARPG.
Paint a single compact, gnarled oak with asymmetric dense broad olive brown foliage masses, readable twisted trunk and exposed roots. Full tree isolated on actual transparent background, no backdrop, no text, no frame, no ground tile, no cast shadow. Root at bottom center, ample transparent margins, entire canopy visible.
Orthographic game view, camera looks down at 43 degrees, azimuth 45 degrees, vertical trunks remain screen vertical. Lighting soft diffuse from upper left, matte weathered bark, very subdued olive foliage, charcoal shadow masses, no bright green. Coarse painterly pre-rendered late-1990s dark fantasy game aesthetic with restrained technical modernization. Broad brush shapes, soft but clear edges; no individually rendered leaves, no microdetail, no thin twigs, no rim glow, no photorealistic noise, no cartoon outlines. Ground contact recognizable. Entirely original design, not any existing game asset. Designed to read at 190 pixels tall in gameplay, not to reward magnification.
prompts.Shrine: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent game environment sprite for an original dark Gothic ARPG: an ancient ruined roadside bell monument. Full monument isolated on actual transparent background with generous empty margins, no text or backdrop. A squat weathered limestone pointed arch on two thick uneven piers, a small old iron bell hanging within the dark opening, broken buttress and three fallen large masonry blocks at its base. No cross, symbols, candles, magic or copied game designs. Compact asymmetric silhouette, broad clearly readable masses. Orthographic view looking down at 43 degrees and azimuth45, verticals screen vertical. Soft light upper left, matte warm grey and moss olive materials, charcoal recesses. Coarse painterly pre-rendered classic dark fantasy game aesthetic, soft readable edges, big chipped surfaces, restrained texture, no tiny cracks or high-contrast speckles. Root bottom center. Designed to read at180 pixels high in gameplay. No cast ground shadow or ground tile.
prompts.Ground: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one square game terrain texture for original dark Gothic ARPG. Seamless quiet open woodland earth, directly overhead orthographic, no perspective/horizon. Entire image filled edge to edge with subdued olive grey loam, broad irregular patches of dry earth and worn muted brown footpath-like bare soil blending organically; extremely sparse broad moss patches. Low contrast palette centered around dark muted #393a2b, darkest #303328, lightest #494635. Coarse painterly brush texture like an original pre-rendered classic dark fantasy game. No recognizable objects, stones, plants, grass blades, leaves, footprints, cracks, speckles, dots, fine noise, bright highlights, grid, lettering, decorative border or dramatic lighting. Very broad subtle tonal brush masses at least 30 pixels across, exceptionally quiet floor so a small armored character remains clear. Flat diffuse soft light with no cast shadows. Natural seamless edges, no dominant central feature. The ground must be matte organic earth, not flat vector shapes or photographic microtexture.
prompts.Rock: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent game environment sprite of a broad squat cluster of three ancient limestone boulders, original Gothic ARPG. Three touching large weathered rocks, uneven dark moss patches at base, no grass, no flowers, no individual pebbles. Full cluster isolated on actual transparent background, ample empty margins, base bottom center, no cast shadow, no ground tile. Orthographic camera looking down43 degrees, azimuth45, matte warm grey stone, subdued olive moss, soft diffuse upper-left light, charcoal right faces. Coarse painterly classic dark fantasy game aesthetic. Broad planes and softened chips, restrained texture. No bright outlines, no hairline cracks, no photographic noise or microdetail. Designed to read at110px wide in gameplay. No text, symbols, frame, copied assets.
